source_basis.finding: Path.resolve defaults strict=False and delegates to Windows flavour realpath. Later stat only checks loops; ordinary disappearance need not turn returned string into a failure.

realpath first calls _getfinalpathname. For an initially successful lookup initial_winerror is0; it performs another _getfinalpathname on the de-prefixed name to verify prefix removal. If name vanishes before that second call, error2 differs from0 and prefix can remain. A file-handle final-name lookup can also observe a renamed/deleted object. String inequality alone is not evidence of a symlink/junction redirect.

historical_PERF21: Saved new fixture demonstrates a reproducible sufficient operational mechanism consistent with PERF21. It does not identify the lost PERF21 triggering path or prove which specific mechanism occurred there. Keep historical cause qualified.

smallest_supported_design.scope: Change only live metadata accounting. Retain strict checked/Handle/member/copy/publication/deletion gates; error-context diagnostic is harmless.
smallest_supported_design.leaf: Use one lstat/DirEntry.stat(follow_symlinks=False) snapshot to inspect regular-file attributes and obtain st_size. Reject observed reparse/symlink/nonregular objects. Never resolve/read target contents for mutable file names. Catch only explicit vanished snapshot outcomes; unexpected permission/IO errors remain refusal.
smallest_supported_design.directory: Maintain lexical containment and no-follow traversal with explicit reparse attribute pruning and directory-ancestry validation. Before/after identities can reject stable or unaccounted changes. Vanished/identity-changed directories during cleanup need bounded skip/retry snapshot semantics rather than blanket accepting arbitrary stable redirects.
smallest_supported_design.no_lock_interference: Do not add strict/no-delete-sharing directory handles in the repeatedly running outer monitor. Such pins can race and fail the authorized cleanup itself. A sampled accounting walker must not change writer/cleanup semantics.
smallest_supported_design.limits: This is sampled logical-size accounting, not a new filesystem security or atomic whole-tree snapshot guarantee. Potential transient ancestor races are disclosed; authoritative operations retain independent strict pinned checks.

required_focused_controls: Real bounded checkpoint churn with ordinary pending->final rename/delete; no false redirect refusal or writer errors in new monitor.
Stable root/nested junction/symlink/reparse fixtures rejected; no target file content dereference or outside-tree traversal treated as accepted payload.
Deterministic vanish/file replacement between enumeration and metadata stat; bounded snapshot behavior, unexpected IO refuses.
Real directory rename/delete and a monitor thread concurrently observing actual focused owned cleanup; no monitor-held handle sharing failures.
Strict original publication/deletion path and negative reparse/containment/alias controls remain unchanged and passing.
Retain exact failing/resolved path/identity diagnostics when a stable directory mismatch truly refuses.
do_not_fix_by: Globally stripping \?\ or ignoring all $Deleted/CompactPathRedirect results
Catching every ValueError/OSError and counting zero
Removing reparse checks or replacing authoritative cleanup/copy validation with monitor observations
Adding deny-DELETE observation locks or any numerical method/gate change
